category_title: Students accustomed to strict, non-negotiable disciplinary models
minimal_context: The student is given multiple worksheets to complete during regular classroom instruction.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Here are three more worksheets for you to complete before the end of class.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: You only give us a lot of work.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Please just focus on finishing the assignment.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Are you going to grade them this time? You never even grade them.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: These are just for practice, they won't be graded. Keep working.

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Then there are some teachers who are always angry. And they only give us a lot of work and they never even grade them. You just don't accept me.

dialogue_combined:
TUTOR: Here are three more worksheets for you to complete before the end of class.

STUDENT: You only give us a lot of work.
